_comment: Centralized Health Agent policy. DB-overridable via config_documents key 'health_agent_policy'. See docs/HEALTH_AGENT.md. No hardcoded values in code — weights/penalties/thresholds/mode all live here.
_mode_help: advisory = score + alert + enqueue escalations (handler/coder act on them). safe = also allow the existing escalation handler's allowlisted retries. Code-level auto-fix is always gated by coder_dispatch's own CODER_DISPATCH_MODE.

remediation_map._comment: finding type -> allowlisted retry_cmd enqueued for claude_escalation_handler tier-1. Only verified, side-effect-safe scripts.

strategy_output._comment: Catch silent-zero strategy failures (FIB-style). Gated to avoid morning false-positives.

log_errors._comment: Scan recently-active component logs for ERROR/Traceback spikes (content, not staleness).
